missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Август' is the masculine nominative subject. 'Жаркий месяц' is the nominative predicate describing what kind of month it is.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Август' is the accusative direct object of 'люблю'; inanimate masculine accusative equals nominative. 'Тёплый' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Genitive in a date phrase. 'Августа' is genitive after 'в начале', a fixed way to say at the beginning of the month.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of time. 'Августе' is prepositional after 'в', the standard way to say in August. 'Дожди' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Dative of time limit. 'Августу' is dative after 'к', meaning by August. 'Яблоки' is the nominative plural subject of 'созревают'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of attribute. 'Августом' is instrumental, naming what made the year memorable. 'Жарким' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Августа' is genitive after 'после', marking what the autumn follows. 'Осень' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Августа' is genitive after 'до', expressing distance in time. 'Ещё далеко' completes the impersonal statement.

missions.phrase: Жаркие августы случаются не каждый год.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Августы' is the nominative plural subject of 'случаются'. 'Жаркие' agrees, generalising about hot Augusts.
Strategic focus: Accusative of duration. 'Август' is accusative expressing the span of time, governed by 'весь'. 'Отпуск' is the nominative subject.
